title: User Management
description: Manage Fable users, their permissions, and library access. Configure user roles and capabilities for your book collection.

currentUsers.sectionDesc: View and manage all registered users, their permissions, and library access.

emptyState.title: No users found
emptyState.subtitle: Create your first user to get started

userInfo.title: User Information
userInfo.showLibraryHint: When on, their personal library appears under USERS in your sidebar and catalog.

contentRestrictions.title: Content Restrictions
contentRestrictions.description: Configure which content this user can see based on categories, tags, moods, or age ratings.
contentRestrictions.emptyHint: This user can access all content in their assigned libraries
contentRestrictions.excludeDesc: Books matching these criteria will be hidden from this user
contentRestrictions.allowOnlyDesc: Only books matching these criteria will be visible to this user
contentRestrictions.infoNote: Exclude rules take priority over Allow Only rules for safety

createDialog.title: Create New User
createDialog.description: Set up a new user account with permissions and library access
createDialog.nameRequired: Name is required and must be at least 3 characters.
createDialog.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email address, or leave blank.
createDialog.passwordMinLength: Password must be at least 8 characters long.
createDialog.libraryRequired: At least one library must be selected.
createDialog.createPersonalLibraryHint: Creates /books/_users/{id}/ and maps it only to this user.
createDialog.showLibraryHint: Off (default): hidden from your catalog. On: appears under the sidebar USERS section only.
createDialog.sharedLibrariesHint: Optional. Leave empty when using a personal library only.
createDialog.permissionPresetHint: Start from a guest-friendly profile. Orange items are admin/system territory — leave them off unless intentional.

presetDescriptions.reader: Read, download, email, sync/OPDS, and viewing stats. No uploads or catalog edits.
presetDescriptions.contributor: Full book work in assigned libraries (upload, edit/delete, bulk metadata) — no path remount or instance settings.
presetDescriptions.librarian: Everything a contributor can do, plus Manage Library for their own libraries. Still no Admin/system settings.
presetDescriptions.admin: Full administrator access to all settings and libraries.

createDialog.footerInfo: Name, username, and password are required. A personal library is created by default.
createDialog.createSuccess: The user has been successfully created.
createDialog.credentialsHint: Copy this block and send it out of band. The Login link opens the sign-in screen and clears any previous session on that browser.
createDialog.credentialsCopyFailed: Could not copy automatically. Select the text and copy manually.
createDialog.createError: An unexpected error occurred while creating the user. Please try again later.

deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete {{username}}?
